fields.body:
## User Stories

- As a memory-api maintainer, I need a repo-local rule workspace so README and usage guidance can live beside the crates and tools they describe.
- As an implementer working on rule-api, I need the local workspace to generate `README.md` directly from canonical rules.
- As a parent-repo maintainer, I need memory-api to expose a reusable workspace summary that memory-viewers can include in parent targets.
fields.title: User Stories

fields.body:
## Tool Surface

| Need | Local operator surface | Agent or integration surface | Service or editor surface |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Manage rules and generated docs | `rule-cli` | `rule-mcp` | generated markdown targets via `rule-targets.yaml` |
| Manage specs | `spec-cli` | `spec-mcp` | `spec-http` |
| Manage tickets and board workflows | `ticket-cli` | `ticket-mcp` | `ticket-http`, `ticket-vscode` |
| Run audits | `audit-cli` | `audit-mcp` | - |

The repository is organized around the question "which surface should I use?" Start with CLI for local operator work, MCP for agent tooling, and HTTP or VS Code when you need remote or UI-facing integration.
